summary: The diff is the round-6 approved version, rebased onto a8b523f1ca65, and I found no source or test defects. This round's durable run broke because of the workspace's dependencies, not the change. ControlPlane.test.ts could not load: `Cannot find module node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/dist/index.js`. The extension-tools Playwright build stopped while pnpm was reinstalling dependencies (`failed to remove existing directory node_modules/maui ... Directory not empty`), so its tests did not run. Because of this, AppGateway.ts:18 has no recorded coverage and the gate fails. Reinstall dependencies cleanly after the rebase, for example by stopping any process that holds node_modules and running `pnpm install`, then rerun the durable suite.

testRequests.target: Rerun durable tests after a clean `pnpm install`: apps/control-plane/test/ControlPlane.test.ts (it must record coverage for AppGateway.ts:18 through 'forwards extension HTTP routes through existing gateway authorization') and packages/extension-tools/test/extension.test.ts
testRequests.rationale: The rebased head's run failed before any control-plane or Playwright test could execute: a missing pi-coding-agent dist and a pnpm install that failed partway on node_modules/maui. A passing run on a correctly installed workspace is needed to meet the test and coverage gates.
